shape_synth_family — SHAPESTAT synth op

• Data kinds: none → shapeset (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.shape_synth_family(n_shapes: 'int' = 8, n_points: 'int' = 64, n_modes: 'int' = 2, mode_scale=(0.3, 0.12), noise: 'float' = 0.0, seed: 'int' = 0) (to call the implementation directly, import shapestats; shapestats.shape_synth_family(n_shapes: 'int' = 8, n_points: 'int' = 64, n_modes: 'int' = 2, mode_scale=(0.3, 0.12), noise: 'float' = 0.0, seed: 'int' = 0); from the registry, opsshapestat.get("shape_synth_family"))

Usage

Creates a family of shapes with known modes of deformation. → (n_shapes, n_points, 3).

The base shape is quasi-uniform points on an ellipsoid, to which orthonormal deformation modes are added with known weights. Mode 1 is stretching along the long axis, mode 2 is left-right bending. When fed to shape_pca, the variance ratio of the principal components should match the ratio of mode_scale to the power of 2, and that is the cross-check of the statistical shape model.

noise is the standard deviation of per-point isotropic Gaussian noise (the component the model does not capture).
